Landing.badge: Now in beta · Free to join
Landing.hero_title: Verify every candidate. Hire with confidence.
Landing.hero_subtitle: Verytis cross-checks CVs against LinkedIn, scores each profile on Fit, Trust and Opportunity, and builds custom assessment pipelines — all in one AI-powered platform.
Landing.post_video_title: One platform for your entire hiring cycle
Landing.post_video_description: From importing candidate lists to scoring pipeline responses, Verytis runs every verification and analysis automatically — so you can focus on the conversations that matter.
Landing.app_step_1_desc: Define the role, requirements, and evaluation criteria. Verytis structures everything for the AI.
Landing.app_step_2_desc: Get a tailored assessment in seconds: scenario questions, MCQ, written answers, file uploads — with anti-cheat and time limits.
Landing.app_step_3_desc: Each submission is scored across CV parsing, pipeline responses, and LinkedIn cross-check — no manual review needed.
Landing.sourcing_step_1_desc: Bring in profiles from Apollo, Lusha, or your own CSV files in one click.
Landing.sourcing_step_2_desc: Each profile is scored on Fit, Trust, and Opportunity. LinkedIn data is cross-checked. Company news is pulled automatically.
Landing.sourcing_step_3_desc: Know who to contact first, and why — based on signals, market context, and your mission criteria.
Landing.features_title: Everything you need to hire right
Landing.features_subtitle: From sourcing to final decision — every step powered by AI.
Landing.feature_integrity_desc: Automatically detect discrepancies between a candidate's CV and their LinkedIn profile. Every verification produces a Trust Score and flags inconsistencies precisely.
Landing.feature_pipeline_desc: Generate role-specific screening questions in seconds: scenario-based, MCQ, written answers, file uploads, and time-limited exercises — with configurable anti-cheat measures.
Landing.feature_market_desc: Every profile is scored on three axes: Fit (match vs. mission), Trust (data reliability from LinkedIn), and Opportunity (likelihood the candidate is open to contact). Clear ranking, no gut feel.
Landing.feature_team_desc: Automated research on each candidate's current employer — funding news, layoffs, growth signals — so you know exactly when and why to reach out.
Landing.feature_cockpit_desc: A conversational AI interface to query your pipeline in real time. Ask who to contact first, get pipeline health summaries, and receive strategic hiring recommendations.
Landing.pricing_subtitle: 200 credits included. No credit card needed.
Landing.pricing_free_desc: Everything you need to test Verytis end-to-end
